profil.wskaz_opis: Choose the game folder and WalkLevel takes the name, icon and colour from it.
profil.wskaz_podpowiedz: Choose the game file (.exe) or its shortcut.
profil.z_gry: The icon and colour come from the game file. You can change them below.
profil.brak_pliku: There is no game file in this folder. Choose the folder with the game .exe file.
profil.online: Show this game on the online account
profil.online_opis: When off, sessions go to the account without the game name.
profil.zacznij_opis: The copy takes the mode, keys, gamepad gears and speeds from the {profil} profile.
profil.utworz: Create profile and switch to it
profil.zacznij_domyslne_opis: The mode, keys, gamepad gears and speeds will be as after installation.
profil.wybierz_ponownie: Choose the game again: select its folder or file.
profil.blad.brak: This game profile does not exist.
profil.blad.ostatni: The last game profile cannot be deleted.
